description: Replace the nested-map archive checkpoint `_actions.archiveChange.destination[changeRel]` in the runner `mohist/archive-change` action with a single run-scoped string variable `openspecArchiveName` (archive directory basename). Persist before the directory move, close the existing-archive backfill gap, read the legacy key with best-effort migration, and keep the `persist-name` retry-safe failure semantics.

tasks.title: Switch archiveChangeAction to openspecArchiveName with backfill and legacy migration
tasks.description: In `packages/runner/src/actions/openspec.ts`, introduce `OPENSPEC_ARCHIVE_NAME_VAR_KEY = "openspecArchiveName"` and replace the `_actions.archiveChange.destination[sourceRel]` read/write contract. Resolve the effective archive name by the priority in design D2: `openspecArchiveName` first, then legacy nested-map entry as best-effort fallback (malformed shape treated as absent via the existing `archiveDestinationMap` read shape), then recompute `${today}-${sourceName}`. Write only `{ openspecArchiveName: basename }` through `context.writeVars` at two sites (design D3): before `moveChangeDir` on a first-time/versioned move, and — new — in the `!sourceHasFiles` branch when `findExistingArchive` returns a directory and no effective name was read, backfilling `openspecArchiveName = basename(existingArchive)` before treating it as the destination. The legacy read naturally migrates to the new key on that write; never write or delete the legacy key. A `writeVars` rejection at either write site returns `{ errorCode: "retry-safe", stage: "persist-name" }` without moving the source (design D4), reusing the existing `persist-name` failure path. Run `validateArchivePrefix` (`openspec.ts:494`) on the effective name from D2 and on the backfilled basename so the existing unsafe-name rejection still applies to both keys (design D5). Drop `archiveDestinationMap`'s write usage but keep its read shape for the legacy fallback. Update `packages/runner/tests/openspec.spec.ts` to assert the new `{ openspecArchiveName }` payload and add coverage for existing-archive backfill, subsequent same-run cross-date retry reusing the backfilled name, backfill persist failure returning `persist-name` retry-safe, legacy-only migration to `openspecArchiveName`, and a legacy-seeded variant of the unsafe-name parametrized test to prove fallback validation.
acceptanceCriteria: `OPENSPEC_ARCHIVE_NAME_VAR_KEY = "openspecArchiveName"` constant exists and the value persisted/ read is the archive directory basename only (never an absolute path, never a map).
`archiveChangeAction` persists `openspecArchiveName` via `context.writeVars` before `moveChangeDir` on a first-time or versioned move (MODIFIED scenario: Archive name persisted before the move).

On retry, the action reads `openspecArchiveName` and reuses that exact basename rather than recomputing from the current date, locating the archive at `${dirname(changeDir)}/archive/${openspecArchiveName}` (MODIFIED scenario: Retry reuses persisted archive name).

A cross-day retry (day N moved+persisted, day N+1 retry) reuses the persisted basename and locates the already-archived directory; it does NOT fail with `missing-source` (MODIFIED scenario: Cross-day retry finds the archived directory).

When the source change directory is gone, `openspecArchiveName` is absent, and `findExistingArchive` matches the current prefix, the action sets `openspecArchiveName` to the matched archive's basename and persists it before continuing, and does NOT fail with `missing-source` (ADDED scenario: Existing archive backfills the archive name).

After a backfill in the same run, a later cross-date retry reads the backfilled `openspecArchiveName` and locates the archive without recomputing the prefix (ADDED scenario: Subsequent same-run retry reuses the backfilled name).

A `writeVars` rejection before the move OR during backfill continuation returns `{ errorCode: "retry-safe", stage: "persist-name" }` and does NOT move the source; a retry of the same task can re-attempt the persist (MODIFIED scenario: Persist failure before move is retry-safe + ADDED scenario: Backfill persist failure is retry-safe).

When only the legacy `_actions.archiveChange.destination[changeRel]` key is present, the action reads the archive basename from the legacy nested-map entry and reuses it (ADDED scenario: Legacy key read for in-flight runs).

When only the legacy key is present, the action best-effort writes `openspecArchiveName` to the basename the legacy entry resolves to (via the before-move or backfill write site), so subsequent retries use the new key; the legacy key is never written or deleted by this code (ADDED scenario: Legacy key migrated to openspecArchiveName).
When both keys are present, the action prefers `openspecArchiveName` and ignores the legacy entry for archive-name resolution (ADDED scenario: Both keys present prefer openspecArchiveName).

`validateArchivePrefix` runs on the effective name from the new key, the legacy fallback, and the backfilled basename, so the existing unsafe-name rejection still applies to both keys; the `ArchiveChangeRejectsUnsafePersistedName_*` parametrized test has a variant that seeds the legacy key to prove fallback validation (design D5).
The action writes only `{ openspecArchiveName: basename }` at both write sites; it never writes `_actions.archiveChange.destination` for any run.

`packages/runner/tests/openspec.spec.ts` updates `ArchiveChangePersistsArchiveNameBeforeMove`, `ArchiveChangeRetryAfterVersionedMove_…`, and `ArchiveChangeCrossDayRetry_…` to assert the new `{ openspecArchiveName }` payload, and adds tests for: existing-archive backfill, subsequent same-run cross-date retry reusing the backfilled name, backfill persist failure returning `persist-name` retry-safe, legacy-only run migrating to `openspecArchiveName`, and a legacy-seeded unsafe-name variant.
The behavior is confined to the runner action runtime-variable contract — no server, DB schema, or workflow YAML (`mohist/github-pr`, `mohist/default`) change, and both profiles inherit the fix.
tasks.output: Modified `packages/runner/src/actions/openspec.ts` (new OPENSPEC_ARCHIVE_NAME_VAR_KEY constant; D2 read-priority order; D3 two-site single-key writes incl. new backfill persist in the `!sourceHasFiles` branch; D4 `persist-name` retry-safe reuse at both write sites; D5 validation on new/legacy/backfilled names; legacy key read-only) and `packages/runner/tests/openspec.spec.ts` (updated assertions + new backfill / cross-date / legacy-migration / persist-failure tests); runner typecheck and tests green.
tasks.notes: Design decisions D1–D5 in openspec/changes/issue-289/design.md are authoritative. The change is runner-only: no DB schema migration, no workflow profile YAML change, no server/web change (confirmed by grep — only openspec.ts and its tests reference the key). Deploy via `mo update runner` per AGENTS.md (not `dotnet run`, to avoid runner id drift). Rollback safety: do not roll back the runner mid in-flight `integrate` runs that started on the new runner — let them drain, since a run persisted only to `openspecArchiveName` would otherwise recompute the prefix on the old runner.
